content.json:
## SOCRadar TAXII 2.1 Dashboard
Threat intelligence indicator analytics from SOCRadar TAXII 2.1 feed imports.

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where SourceSystem == "SOCRadar TAXII"
| summarize Count=dcount(Id)
| project Count
content.title: Total TI Indicators

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where SourceSystem == "SOCRadar TAXII"
| extend TagList = split(Tags, ",")
| mv-expand Tag = TagList
| where tostring(Tag) startswith "collection-"
| summarize Count=dcount(tostring(Tag))
| project Count
content.title: Active Sources

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where SourceSystem == "SOCRadar TAXII"
| summarize Count=dcount(ObservableKey)
| project Count
content.title: Indicator Types

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where SourceSystem == "SOCRadar TAXII"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize Count=dcount(Id)
| project Count
content.title: Last 24 Hours

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where SourceSystem == "SOCRadar TAXII"
| summarize Count=count() by ObservableKey
| order by Count desc
content.title: Indicators by Type

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where SourceSystem == "SOCRadar TAXII"
| extend TagList = split(Tags, ",")
| mv-expand Tag = TagList
| where tostring(Tag) startswith "collection-"
| summarize Count=count() by tostring(Tag)
| order by Count desc
content.title: Indicators by Source

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where SourceSystem == "SOCRadar TAXII"
| summarize Count=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Indicators Over Time

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where SourceSystem == "SOCRadar TAXII"
| project TimeGenerated, ObservableKey, ObservableValue, Confidence, ValidFrom, ValidUntil
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Recent Indicators

content.query:
SOCRadar_TAXII_Audit_CL
| summarize Count=count() by Status
| order by Count desc
content.title: Import Run Status

content.query:
SOCRadar_TAXII_Audit_CL
| summarize Created=sum(IndicatorsCreated), Failed=sum(IndicatorsFailed), Revoked=sum(IndicatorsRevoked) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Indicators Created, Failed and Revoked

content.query:
SOCRadar_TAXII_Audit_CL
| project TimeGenerated, ApiRoot, CollectionId, IndicatorsCreated, IndicatorsSkipped, IndicatorsFailed, IndicatorsRevoked, DurationMs, Status, ErrorMessage
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 20
content.title: Recent Import Runs
